name: mudanzify-backend
description: Mudanzify desktop backend: Electron main process, preload bridge and IPC.
author: MarioZaMu

scripts.dev: npm run build && wait-on --timeout 120000 http-get://localhost:5173 && cross-env MUDANZIFY_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix ../mudanzify-frontend run dev" "npm run dev"
scripts.dist: npm run renderer:build && npm run renderer:copy && npm run build && electron-builder --win
